scope: Local cached reference path correction; disposable native regressions and authorized assembly working-copy repair. No upload, check-in or server mutation.
native_checks: App::Link reproduces stale paths after native Save As
App::Link ordinary save repairs paths and keeps live references
App::Link preserves placements, labels and internal links
App::Link repeated save keeps repaired paths
App::Link still rejects genuine reference changes
App::Link writable Save As repairs paths and preserves its source
App::Link reopens with exact targets and placements
Assembly::AssemblyLink reproduces stale paths after native Save As
Assembly::AssemblyLink ordinary save repairs paths and keeps live references
Assembly::AssemblyLink preserves placements, labels and internal links
Assembly::AssemblyLink repeated save keeps repaired paths
Assembly::AssemblyLink still rejects genuine reference changes
Assembly::AssemblyLink writable Save As repairs paths and preserves its source
Assembly::AssemblyLink reopens with exact targets and placements
retained_callbacks: ForgePDM_Upload resolves current action before execution
ForgePDM_CheckIn resolves current action before execution

working_copy.placements: Native recompute numerical changes in three placements; maximum absolute coordinate delta below 8e-31 mm.
working_copy.pdf_limitation: Three existing bindings require explicit relinking: two have old view-scale evidence; one differs in component geometry hashes. Bindings were preserved and no PDF was published.

behavior: Ordinary saves and writable Save As inspect serialized paths, refreshing only stale supported native link caches. Unresolved or different target identities are left to strict transfer validation; unsupported archives are not repaired.
limits: No production HTTP mutation or PDF publication
Six optional Qt modules skipped in the base suite
